WITH channel_execution_counts AS (
  SELECT
    o.orderbase,
    AVG(oe.fillcount) AS avg_filled_quantity,
    COUNT(*) AS execution_count
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN orderexecutions AS oe
    ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.orderbase
)
SELECT
  orderbase AS channel,
  avg_filled_quantity,
  execution_count,
  execution_count::numeric / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS execution_fraction
FROM channel_execution_counts;
